widgets_values:
## FLUX.2 Klein + LoRA — Text → Image

**Bản này gộp cả GGUF lẫn safetensors.** Không còn dùng *Fast Groups Bypasser* /
*Any Switch* (rgthree, chỉ chạy ở frontend, khó bật/tắt và không dùng được khi
chạy API). Thay bằng node lõi **If/Else Switch** (`ComfySwitchNode`) + **Boolean**:
tick 1 ô là đổi nhánh, nhánh không chọn **không hề chạy** (lazy input) nên
không tốn VRAM/RAM để load model thừa.

### Các công tắc
| Ô Boolean | Bật (true) | Tắt (false) |
|---|---|---|
| `GGUF hay safetensors?` | UNet + CLIP GGUF | UNet + CLIP safetensors |
| `Prompt: auto .txt hay gõ tay?` | B — đọc từ file/folder .txt | A — gõ tay ở ô Positive/Negative |

Chọn 9B hay 4B: đổi thẳng dropdown trên node loader (phải đổi **cả UNet lẫn text
encoder**, không được trộn 9B ↔ Qwen3-4B).

### Model & nơi đặt file (ComfyUI/models/...)
| File | Đặt vào |
|---|---|
| `flux-2-klein-base-9b-Q5_K_M.gguf` | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf` (distilled) | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf` (TE cho 9B, GGUF) | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf` (TE cho 4B, GGUF) | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors` (TE cho 9B) | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `qwen_3_4b_fp4_mixed.safetensors` (TE cho 4B) | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `flux2-vae.safetensors` | `models/vae/` |
| LoRA `*FluxKlein*.safetensors` | `models/loras/` |

### Base vs distilled — QUAN TRỌNG cho CFG
- LoRA của bạn train trên bản **Base** → dùng `flux-2-klein-base-9b-*.gguf`,
  **CFG 4–5, 20 bước**.
- File safetensors đang có trên máy là `flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors` —
  **bản distilled**, không có chữ `base`. Chạy bản này thì để **CFG 1.0** và
  ~8–12 bước, LoRA base vẫn ăn nhưng yếu hơn. Muốn safetensors đúng base thì
  tải `flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors` (Comfy-Org) rồi chọn lại ở dropdown.

### LoRA
Vẫn dùng **Power Lora Loader (rgthree)** — node này có backend thật
(`RgthreePowerLoraLoader.load_loras` đọc cờ `on` của từng dòng), nên nút bật/tắt
LoRA ăn cả khi chạy API, khác hẳn *Fast Groups Bypasser*. Tắt 1 LoRA = bỏ qua
hẳn, không load. Nếu muốn bỏ rgthree hoàn toàn thì thay bằng chuỗi
`LoraLoaderModelOnly` của core + 1 Boolean/If-Else cho mỗi LoRA (nhiều node hơn).

nodes.title: B-TXT auto: đọc prompt từ file .txt
widgets_values:
Create a highly photorealistic iPhone photograph of a clearly adult young man relaxing on a sofa at night.
Subject & Pose:
He is leaning comfortably into the sofa, with his torso angled slightly toward the camera and his upper body naturally reclined. One arm rests downward along the sofa/cushioned surface, while the other arm is raised in front of his torso holding a smartphone vertically. His head is tilted downward toward the phone, with his gaze directed toward the screen. Maintain the same shoulder orientation, elbow placement, hand positioning, leg placement, torso rotation, and overall body angle as the reference. Keep natural human anatomy and realistic proportions.
Appearance: Clearly adult male with a natural masculine facial features. Preserve realistic skin texture, pores, subtle tonal variation, natural shadows, and fine facial details. No plastic or airbrushed appearance. Outfit:
He is shirtless and wearing a loose, relaxed-fit pajama/lounge pants: soft fabric with alternating light blue, white, and muted gray-blue vertical stripes, slightly wrinkled naturally around the knees and thighs. Preserve the relaxed homewear aesthetic. Room & Background: Transform the same interior into a believable nighttime setting. Keep the original room layout and major architectural elements: modern living area, large light-colored sofa, soft cushions/blankets, pale walls, wall-mounted split air-conditioning unit, doorway/opening in the background, and decorative dark wall panel with the curved floral/vine artwork. Outside light sources should suggest nighttime rather than daylight. Use warm practical interior lighting combined with subtle cool ambient nighttime light entering from the windows/openings. The room should remain clearly visible, naturally illuminated, and dimensional—not excessively dark.
Lighting: Soft warm bedside/living-room illumination around 3000–3500K, supplemented by faint cool blue nighttime ambient light around 5000–6500K. Gentle directional illumination across the face and upper body, realistic falloff into the background, soft shadows, subtle reflected light from the phone screen, natural highlights on hair and skin. Avoid harsh flash, blown highlights, artificial studio lighting, or dramatic cinematic darkness. Camera & Composition: Shot as a realistic modern iPhone photograph, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Camera positioned approximately at chest/upper-waist height, slightly below the subject's eye level, matching the perspective of the reference. Use a natural smartphone wide/main-camera perspective with minimal distortion. Keep the same close environmental framing and perspective, showing the subject from head through the legs and enough surrounding room to establish the setting. Natural handheld smartphone composition, realistic optical rendering, subtle computational HDR, accurate depth and perspective. Image Quality & Color Grading: Ultra-high-definition, extremely sharp but natural details, realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, authentic fabric texture and wrinkles, realistic sofa fibers, physically accurate shadows and reflections. Apply a soft nighttime cinematic color grade with slightly warm skin tones, neutral whites, gentle cool-blue shadows, controlled highlights, moderate contrast, subtle HDR, slightly lifted dark areas, and natural tonal transitions. Keep the image looking like an authentic iPhone night photograph rather than a heavily edited cinematic render. Negative Prompt: tattoos, tattoo remnants, body markings, lettering on skin, symbols on skin, artificial muscles, exaggerated anatomy, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed limbs, altered pose, altered body angle, changed camera perspective, plastic skin, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, airbrushed face, CGI, 3D render, illustration, anime, cartoon, oversaturated colors, harsh flash, extreme darkness, blown highlights, unrealistic shadows, wide-angle distortion, fisheye distortion, duplicate objects, artificial-looking background.
